dashboard.meta_description: English JetScope dashboard for SAF versus jet-fuel decisions, including market snapshot, scenarios, source posture, and launch-readiness actions.
dashboard.title: Decision Cockpit
dashboard.question: Has today's market and data-delivery posture changed enough to require a scenario rerun?
dashboard.decision_hint_fallback: The API fallback is not a measured input; review the source before re-running a scenario.
dashboard.decision_hint_alert: The history window is in alert; review the sources and re-run with current market inputs.
dashboard.decision_hint_unknown: The history window has not produced an identifiable signal; do not treat unknown as normal.
dashboard.decision_hint_source: Source status is not healthy; review the evidence before continuing with the scenario.
dashboard.decision_hint_watch: Risk is in the watch range; review key assumptions before a re-run.
dashboard.decision_hint_ok: Source status and the risk window do not currently require a review.
dashboard.risk_hint_none: No historical risk signal is available yet; unknown evidence is not a normal state.

dashboard.provenance_why: Trust state for every number on this screen: observed, proxy, or fallback.
dashboard.price_trends_why: The snapshot is one point; the 1d / 7d / 30d windows show whether it is unusual.
dashboard.capabilities_why: This capability list describes the product surface that supports the decision; it is not itself a market conclusion.
priorities: Market data: Brent, global jet fuel, EU jet proxy, and carbon proxy.
Scenario context: saved assumptions and recent workspace records.
Source quality: confidence, fallback use, and degraded evidence stay visible.
Launch posture: admin and research prerequisites are handled in the operations console.
dashboard.migration_why: These rails explain how a safe fallback and the next workspace expansion are handled.
dashboard.scenarios_why: Saved scenarios are local assumptions for comparison and do not replace a reviewed procurement decision.
dashboard.scenarios_empty: No saved scenarios yet. Use the primary scenario workspace to create and compare operating assumptions.

dashboard.sources_matrix_why: This is the evidence layer behind the market snapshot: live, proxy, fallback, and confidence remain visible together.

limitations: When coverage is healthy, live metrics prefer primary or official sources.
Proxy metrics and fallback values are labeled separately.
Confidence, lag, and degraded reasons are available on Source Review.
Fallback values keep the cockpit available but are never presented as measurements.
The risk signal depends on history-window sample size; no alert does not mean no risk.
Saved scenarios are local assumptions for review and discussion.

faq.meta_description: JetScope FAQ for launch readiness, source review, research workbench boundaries, scenario writes, and protected operations.
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.question: Is this state a product failure, or is the capability intentionally not enabled?

scope.title: What can JetScope review today?
scope.why: The stated review scope shows which decisions the product can support without overstating its reach.
scope.body: JetScope combines jet-fuel prices, SAF breakeven pressure, EU reserve stress, source quality, saved scenario assumptions, and research signals into one review workflow.

readiness.title: Why can launch readiness be not ready?
readiness.why: Separating configuration gaps from product failures makes the correct recovery action clear.
readiness.body: Launch readiness reports the actual environment. Missing management configuration, disabled AI research, database issues, or degraded source coverage are disclosed as blockers or review items instead of being hidden.

sources.title: How should I read degraded or fallback sources?
sources.why: A degraded source changes where its figures are safe to use and therefore needs review before citation.
sources.body: Source review separates live, proxy, fallback, unavailable, and error states. A degraded source can still be useful, but it should be reviewed before procurement or reporting use.

research.title: Why might the research workbench be disabled?
research.why: Disabled research is not evidence that the market produced no new signal.
research.body: The Research workbench does not pretend that AI analysis is live when the pipeline is disabled or credentials are incomplete. It shows the boundary and the next review actions.

scenarios.title: Can I save scenarios or refresh market data here?
scenarios.why: Protected writes need explicit authorization before a read-only state can be treated as a malfunction.
scenarios.body: Scenario writes and refresh operations are protected. Without the configured management token, localized FAQ pages and review surfaces stay read-only and link back to the primary workspaces.

limitations: These answers describe the current deployment design intent and do not change with live data; use the Admin page for the environment’s actual readiness.
The FAQ does not replace the current states and limitations on the Sources, Research, or Scenarios pages.
